definitions.gloss: to scatter, to make a mess, to clutter
definitions.explanation: To cause disorder by spreading things around untidily.

examples.english: Don't make a mess of the room.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がおもちゃを{散|ち}らかした。
examples.english: The child made a mess with toys.

examples.japanese: {片付|かたづ}けたばかりなのに、また{散|ち}らかさないでください。
examples.english: I just cleaned up, so please don't make a mess again.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Intransitive pair: {散|ち}らかる (to be messy).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state or ongoing action. {散|ち}らかしている = 'has made messy' or 'is making messy.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Xを{散|ち}らかす (to scatter X, make X messy)
- {部屋|へや}を{散|ち}らかす (to mess up a room)
- {散|ち}らかさないで (don't make a mess)

INTRANSITIVE PAIR:
- {散|ち}らかす (transitive) - to make messy
- {散|ち}らかる (intransitive) - to be messy

NOTE: Often used in negative requests: {散|ち}らかさないで！ (Don't make a mess!)
